Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Melson
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 04/16/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 57 as passed the Senate will increase the administrative obligations of (1) the State Lands Division of the Department of Conservation and Natural Resources (DCNR) by a small undetermined amount to provide approval regarding rights-of-way over unused public land managed by DCNR and (2) the controlling government entity of a road or highway to approve new access points from public unused land as provided by this bill. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Jim Hill, Chair
Judiciary

Committee: Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry
Sponsor: Melson
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 02/10/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 57 as introduced and as amended and reported by the Committee on Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry will increase the obligations of the State Lands Division of the Department of Conservation and Natural Resources by a small undetermined amount to provide written approval regarding rights-of-way over unused public land. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Larry Stutts, Chairperson
Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry
